prose_note: Prose color roles (Colorful Language) are derived, not stored. Vivid gives each role a saturated hue: the proper-noun role takes the accent's hue, the others take the unused theme color nearest their target hue (secondary emphasis, charts) or a synthesized one; each moves in OKLCH lightness to 4.5:1 on the page and is kept at least 0.08 ΔE_OK from ink, muted and every other role. Clear reuses Vivid's proper, number and quote colors and recedes function words and punctuation to prose-recede at about 3:1. Subtle mixes muted or the role colors with ink at 4.5:1 or more. prose-content is ink raised to 7:1 when the theme's ink is below it.
